fields.description: Minimum days between two calving events for the same animal. Default 270 (~9 months).
fields.label: Minimum Calving Interval (Days)

fields.description: Minimum age (months) of the herd where newborn calves are placed. Matches Herds.min_age.
fields.label: Default Calf Herd Min Age

fields.description: Maximum age (months) of the herd where newborn calves are placed. Matches Herds.max_age.
fields.label: Default Calf Herd Max Age

fields.description: Animal must be at least this age (months) before it can be served/inseminated.
fields.label: Minimum Service Age (Months)

fields.description: Animal must be at least this age (months) to record a calving event.
fields.label: Minimum Calving Age (Months)

fields.description: Service is blocked before this many days after a Calving.
fields.label: Minimum Days to Service After Calving

fields.description: Service is allowed but warned about before this many days after a Calving. Also sets Ready For Service Date.
fields.label: Optimal Days to Service After Calving

fields.description: Service is blocked before this many days after an Abortion. Set to 0 to disable.
fields.label: Minimum Days to Service After Abortion

fields.description: Expected Calving Date = service date + this.
fields.label: Gestation Period (days)

fields.description: How many days before the expected calving date the reminder fires.
fields.label: Calving Alert Lead (days)

fields.description: Pregnancy diagnosis earlier than this warns about accuracy.
fields.label: Earliest Reliable Diagnosis (days after service)

fields.description: Pregnancy diagnosis later than this warns as overdue.
fields.label: Latest Expected Diagnosis (days after service)

fields.description: Calves created by a Birth event go to this herd. If unset, the calf-rearing herd is resolved automatically.
fields.label: Default Calf Herd

fields.description: Minimum days between identical vaccinations for the same animal.
fields.label: Min Vaccination Interval (Days)

fields.description: Minimum days between deworming events for the same animal.
fields.label: Min Deworming Interval (Days)

fields.description: Minimum age for dehorning. Usually done on young calves.
fields.label: Min Dehorning Age (Months)

fields.description: Maximum recommended age for dehorning.
fields.label: Max Dehorning Age (Months)

fields.description: Minimum days between weight recordings for the same animal.
fields.label: Min Weight Recording Interval (Days)

fields.description: Minimum days between hoof trimming for the same animal.
fields.label: Min Hoof Trimming Interval (Days)

fields.description: Store where manufactured feed (TMR) is produced and held.
fields.label: Feed WIP / Store Warehouse

fields.description: Stock item representing raw milk.
fields.label: Milk Item

fields.description: Warehouse net sellable milk is posted into.
fields.label: Milk Target Warehouse

fields.description: Warehouse discarded/withheld milk is posted into.
fields.label: Milk Discard Warehouse

fields.description: Warehouses feed inputs may be drawn from, in search order. The first row that can cover a line in full is the one the Work Order transfers from. The Feed WIP / Store Warehouse above is always tried last.
fields.label: Feed Source Warehouses

fields.description: Concentrates the farm buys ready-packed. A concentrate that is mixed on the farm is recognised by its BOM and does not belong here — list only the ones that arrive already made, so the feeding programme flags them as concentrate rather than plain raw material.
fields.label: Bought-in Concentrates

fields.description: Default source warehouse for vaccination and deworming drug issues. Each drug row can override it.
fields.label: Drug Store

fields.description: Warehouse the semen straws are issued from. Falls back to the Drug Store when unset.
fields.label: Semen Store

fields.description: Default straw item for a Service when none is chosen on the event.
fields.label: Default Semen Item
A · Calf Intake
fields.description: Which herd a newborn enters. A calf's sex decides this and nothing else does.

fields.label: Female Calf Herd
fields.description: Normally the first rung of the growth ladder below.

fields.label: Male Calf Herd
fields.description: Bull calves. Culling settings below apply to this herd.

fields.label: Cull Bulls After Birth
fields.description: Some farms sell a bull calf almost as soon as it is born. Tick this and the system will warn before the window closes.

fields.label: Maximum Days on Farm
fields.description: Longest a bull calf should remain before it is sold.

fields.label: Warn At (% of window)
fields.description: At 75% of 14 days the warning fires on day 10.5.

fields.label: B · Growth Ladder
fields.description: The herds a heifer climbs before she is old enough to serve, in order. The first row is where female calves land; the last should be marked 'exits on service'.

fields.label: C · First Pregnancy
fields.description: Where a served heifer waits out her first pregnancy. She gives no milk yet, which is why this herd is separate from the lactation groups.

fields.label: Incalf Heifer Herd
fields.description: Entered on a CONFIRMED pregnancy, never on the service alone.

fields.label: General Time (days)
fields.description: A heifer that repeatedly fails to conceive should not sit here indefinitely; past this she is flagged for a decision.

fields.label: Leaves for Steamers (days before calving)
fields.description: 3 months for a first pregnancy. Counted back from the calving date, which is the service date plus Gestation Period (General tab).

fields.label: D · Lactation Cycle
fields.description: After her first calving a cow never returns to the growth ladder. She cycles between these herds for the rest of her productive life.

fields.label: Milked After Conceiving (days)
fields.description: 4 months from conception, then she steps down to the low yield herd.

fields.label: Maximum Open Days
fields.description: A cow that has not conceived in this many days has expired from the high yield herd on productivity grounds.

fields.label: Days in Low Yield Herd
fields.description: 2 months. Fixed — it does not vary with yield or anything else.

fields.label: Steamers · the dry herd
fields.description: Two streams meet here, and how long an animal stays depends on which one it came from — so the duration belongs to the route, not to the herd.

fields.label: Dry Days · arriving from Incalf Heifers
fields.description: A first-time heifer arrives with 3 months to calving.

fields.label: Dry Days · arriving from Low Yield
fields.description: A cow arrives with 2 months to calving.
